text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that Super Creek is doing<n>some solo dance
training, I decide to<n>drop by and watch.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I have to say... Hehe. I liked the<n>way you were
looking at me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Your eyes were sparkling like a<n>child's.
choice_data_list:
I couldn't help myself with how much fun you
seemed to be having.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, are you getting the urge to<n>dance too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad to hear it! Let's dance<n>together
next!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. We still have some time<n>before the next
person comes to<n>practice. What do you say?
choice_data_list: I'd hate to interrupt your practice...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. We still have some time<n>before the next
person comes to<n>practice. What do you say?
choice_data_list: I'd hate to interrupt your practice...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It makes me happy to see you this<n>excited!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I can't believe I get to dance<n>with you,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll be the one with thesparkling eyes this time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek beams as we take to the<n>stage, and
the two of us enjoy our<n>dance together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I've been dancing all on my own<n>this whole
time, and I'm feeling rather<n>lonely...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there a kind trainer out there<n>who could
possibly dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek takes my hand, and we<n>have fun
dancing together. She<n>appears to learn something
from<n>watching my movements.
